prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Try Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice hiding, summoning, and talking to your pet right on your desktop before completing setup.", "Interactive control sandbox modes"]
1: ["Initializing Desktop Rendering Engine", "We are calibrating your pet's desktop overlay system. Real-time display diagnostics below.", "Display Drivers & Desktop Overlay Verification"]
2: ["Master Your Pet Controls", "Listen to short audio cues and watch video demonstrations to learn desktop shortcuts.", "Audio Control Walkthrough", "Desktop Pet Controls Preview"]
3: ["Discover Companion Stories", "Explore companion origins before selecting your onboarding journey."]
4: ["Signing in syncs your account cloud backup so your active pets and progress are never lost."]
5: ["Desktop pet rendering usually takes 1-3 minutes while graphic assets prepare."]
6: ["Your Companion is Ready!", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to tweak settings, right-click your pet to hide or summon, and double-click to talk.", "Launch Desktop Companion"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name and register your new desktop pet to finalize its personalized identity."]
8: ["Uploading clear, well-lit photos unlocks high-definition pet textures and special desktop animations."]
9: ["We will chime and alert you as soon as your desktop pet is fully rendered."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for photo uploads and offers unlocked extra features as an incentive.
